scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the envelope and coexistence conditions from the submitted (z,T) points against the paper's analytic equations (18) and (21), and verifies tricritical point against exact analytic values.

hidden_assets.purpose: Analytic gold values for tricritical point and the transition-line equations.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper equations (18)-(21) and discussion; tricritical point from paper (z*=1/4π, T*=0.25).
hidden_assets.generation_method: Hardcoded constants and analytic formulas derived from the paper.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly traceable to the published paper and are not arbitrarily chosen.

outputs.description: Points on the continuous (KT) and first-order transition lines in the fugacity-temperature plane.
Coordinates (z*, T*) of the tricritical point.

output_contract.notes: The transition_lines.csv points must satisfy the marginal-stability envelope (continuous line) or the equal-potential condition (first-order line) within prescribed tolerances. The tricritical point is compared to the exact values derived in the paper. The agent should generate a dense enough (z,T) grid to resolve the transition curves smoothly.

steps.note: Verifies each (z,T,type) point against the paper's analytic KT line (T=0.25, 0≤z≤z_star) and first-order coexistence equation (21).
Compares the reported tricritical point (z_star, T_star) to exact analytic values (1/(4π), 0.25) with absolute tolerance 1e-4.
